Microsoft develops device and app management solutions through its Intune platform. The Software Engineer will design, develop, maintain, and safely release scalable software and client components across multiple platforms, collaborate with engineering teams, use modern AI tools, and resolve customer issues.

Designs, develops, and maintains software across a variety of platforms and technology stacks, including highly scaled .NET services and client components on iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and the web
Collaborates with engineers across teams to deliver software solutions that millions of people rely on to get their work done
Contributes to the development of customer-focused products and services while working in a collaborative engineering environment
Leverages modern AI tools to design and implement software for various tech stacks
Collaborates with other engineers to solve urgent customer problems
